name: Haus Handle
beschreibung:
Perched on a sunny terrace above the Inn Valley in Grins, Haus Handle welcomes guests with friendly family hospitality and comfortable rooms. It makes a versatile hub for hiking and culture.

Landeck Castle, the Venet ski and hiking mountain, and trails across the Lechtal Alps are reached in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Handle in Grins provides sunny relaxation and panoramic valley views near Landeck in TirolWest.
